channel.title: Comments on: Am I the man that I was coached to be?
channel.description: Insights from work, home, and fatherhood and how they all mix together

item.title: By: Jennifer Paulson
item.dc:creator: Jennifer Paulson
item.description: Tony, thank you so much for sharing this. It gives us lots to think about and how we choose to move forward after 2020 is a memory. Take good care. Merry Christmas to your family.

item.title: By: Luke B
item.dc:creator: Luke B
item.description: Tony, that was a way cool thing that you wrote. Very true, we do need to question if we are doing everything the things the way we should. Thank you for getting that word out. Hope your family is doing good and have a good Christmas.
